private: Keep this file private. It lives in versions/, which is NOT part of the deploy zip (it IS part of the dev zip, so do not share the dev zip).
purpose: Invented, clearly fictional lessons (world: Orrowmere) with rare names. If these names appear in someone else's product or dataset, the lessons were copied from Midel. Check with: npm run canary:check -- <file-or-url>
shortLines: The Kelvarn Reach is a fictional plateau.
Tolvik birds are fictional birds with glass feathers.
Drellmoor is a fictional city in Orrowmere.
note: These names were not found in the library before they were added. They were NOT searched for on the web (no web access when they were created): treat one match as a lead, several different names together as strong evidence.
